about: Special days on the archive calendars. type 'maintenance': the site was down; shows 8 PM red ('Maintenance · nothing published'), not clickable, never counts as published, ignored if the date has an edition. type 'launch': launch day; shows the aqua-green theme color ('Launch day'); not clickable when it has no editions, otherwise the day stays clickable with a green ring. Add a date here and run tools/publish.py.
